rule: Run verify_lock.py first, from a clean checkout of the candidate commit. If it fails, do not open, scan or read any reserve or Q4 case.

candidate.commit: the commit that adds this file (branch claude/arm-f-relock, parent origin/main eb697a31)

scorer.source: scripts/ at the candidate commit (identical to origin/main eb697a31)

models.triage_stage1: claude-haiku-5-5, 3 fresh agents per part (Ha, Hb, Hc)
models.triage_stage2: claude-sonnet-5-5, 3 fresh agents per part (Sa, Sb, Sc)
models.adjudicators: a fresh claude-opus-5-5 and a fresh claude-fable-5-2

steps: 1. verify_lock.py REPO HARNESS_SCRIPTS OPENGREP -> LOCK VERIFIED
2. score the reserve once: node scripts/recall_harness.mjs score --manifest RESERVE --rules RULES --opengrep ENGINE --workdir W --checkpoint-dir FRESH --out SCORE plus engine.score_args
3. node scripts/recall_harness.mjs review-alerts --score SCORE --score-sha256 SHA --workdir W --out alerts.json
4. build_packet.py RUN 20261127 RULES alerts.json=SCORE; record packet and key digests; split packet.json into parts of <= 64 items
5. stage 1: three fresh Haiku agents per part with triage_agent_prompt.txt -> triage-H{a,b,c}-partN.json
6. score_arm_g.py RUN --stage2 stage2.json; split; three fresh Sonnet agents per part with triage_agent_prompt.txt -> triage-S{a,b,c}-partN.json
7. labels (independent of steps 5-6): one Opus and one Fable agent per part of packet.json with labeler_prompt.txt -> labels-opus.json, labels-fable.json
8. adjudication_packet.py RUN; one fresh Opus and one fresh Fable agent with adjudication_prompt.txt -> adjudication-opus.json, adjudication-fable.json
9. score_arm_g.py RUN SCORE -> arm G endpoints and secondaries, once; Q4 run separately with the same steps

Blinding: triage agents never see labels; labelers and adjudicators never see triage outputs, key.json, rule ids, tiers or arms. A failed agent call is retried once, then its verdicts count as missing (SUPPRESS). All prompts and raw outputs are kept with the receipt.
whole_repo_endpoint: not part of arm G; a separate comparison later
